items.docs:
Use this endpoint to create a virtual card chargeback. 

What is behind this API?
- When a user calls this API, we will create a new case/dispute to Marqeta
- When case/dispute creation success, the API will transmit the case for Marqeta review
- When the review passes, the API will transmit the case to the Card Network for Chargeback
